summary: Lookout site on Kaniksu National Forest, Bonner County. Jay Peak's history mentions a camp atop Elmira Peak. No structure details found.

evidence.supports: Elmira Peak listed as a lookout site on Kaniksu National Forest
Elmira Peak is in Bonner County
Page sits under the Idaho heading of the Forest Lookouts site
Elmira Peak is listed on Forest Lookouts (Ron Kemnow)
Location given as township 59 north, range 1 west, section 2
Jay Peak lists a 50-foot pole tower dated 1930
Camp atop Elmira Peak, four miles southwest of Jay Peak
evidence.quote: Also a camp 4 miles southwest atop Elmira Peak

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Kemnow's page gives only the county, forest and legal location; no kind, date, height, or status. The Jay Peak history (Idaho Fire Lookouts) mentions a camp atop Elmira Peak but gives no date or user. Elmira Peak is not in the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Idaho list (firelookout.org/lookouts/us/id/) and the NHLR Idaho index in our cache has no entry for it. The Idaho Fire Lookouts region index is paginated and only its first page was read. The record's coordinates were not checked against any source. Consider whether the site should be a 'camp' or 'lookout site' rather than a tower.
